name: franchise-operations-intelligence
description: Guided analytics workflows, governed metric definitions, schema remediation scripts, and a Cortex Agent for franchise multi-unit owners managing unit performance, benchmarking, labor, COGS/waste, compliance, and expansion across a QSR Brands network.
notes: alerts.sql references a notification integration named FRANCHISE_OPS_NOTIFY that must be created before resuming alerts. Replace the placeholder email address in setup.sql with your real ops-alerts address. The LABOR_WEEKLY schema-remediation block uses session variables and must be executed as a single statement batch.
